# Spark Control Center 1.1.0

This release adds safer submission workflows, namespace-level authorization, real-time updates, reusable application manifests, and persisted lifecycle diagnostics.

## New in 1.1.0

- Kubernetes server-side dry-run before submission, with original and normalized YAML comparison.
- Per-user namespace assignments enforced by the backend on reads, mutations, audit records, and live events.
- Kubernetes Watch changes streamed to the browser through Server-Sent Events, with polling fallback.
- Clone and retry actions that remove runtime status and server-owned metadata before editing.
- PostgreSQL lifecycle snapshots and rule-based failure diagnosis for common Kubernetes and Spark failures.

## Release assets

- `spark-control-center-1.1.0.tar` — frontend image, load with `docker load -i`.
- `spark-control-center-backend-1.1.0.tar` — backend image, load with `docker load -i`.
- `spark-control-center-1.1.0.tgz` — Helm chart.
- `SHA256SUMS` — checksums for all packaged assets.

The image names inside the tar archives are `spark-control-center:1.1.0` and `spark-control-center-backend:1.1.0`; no private registry prefix is included.
